versionNotes: Full source-version collation remains GAP01. All sourceIssues explicitly concern final arXivv3; they are not represented as verified published errata.

summary: Full final-arXiv reading checkpoint for arithmetic nilpotent p-adic Simpson, geometric and arithmetic de Rham functors, arbitrary pullback, qualified proper pushforward, local/global rigidity and canonical Shimura local systems. The existing T6:comparison owns the ordinary Riemann–Hilbert/rigidity prefix; shared period, connection, cohomology, torus and canonical-model owners are imported. Extend the existing HodgeStructuresPartII candidate only for shared Higgs/parameter-connection algebra and propose a geometric-toric-tower continuation of the cyclotomic phi-Gamma roadmap. Record12 source findings, including a false Tate–Sen inequality with a concrete cyclotomic counterexample. Publication collation and recursive/declaration closure remain open.

For a scheme S, a geometric point Spec Ω → S gives a point of the small étale site with fibre X ↦ Hom_S(Spec Ω, X) on étale S-schemes, and these points are conservative. Tau Ceti makes finite topological covering spaces a Galois category. Neither library proves the Galois-category axioms for finite étale algebras or covers of a scheme, and there is no étale fundamental group.

targets.target: Recovery of the absolute Galois group as the fundamental group of Spec K
